TECHNICAL DATA SHEET 
 
 Spray-Net Exclusive Paint Series  
 Waterborne-Polyurethane 
 Kitchen Cabinet Coating  
 
 
DESCRIPTION: Spray-Net’s exclusive Waterborne-
Polyurethane Kitchen Cabinet Coating is a high-quality 
Waterborne Polyurethane system designed for kitchen 
cabinets use. This system provides excellent color and gloss 
retention, good chemical and stain resistance, good film 
integrity and hardness. The excellent adhesion of this coating 
provides high durability and protection. 
 
APPLICATIONS: Finish coat for all kinds of Kitchen 
cabinet surfaces such as Melamine, MDF, Veneers and 
Natural wood. 
 
COLORS: Available in Standard industry colors and glosses. 
Also available in custom colors. All colors are shaded using 
high grade quality pigments and components. 
 
SURFACE PREPARATION: Coating performance is 
proportional to the degree of surface preparation. All 
surfaces must be clean, dimensionally stable, dry and free 
from dust, grease, dirt and all other contaminants.  
 
MIXING: Paint Component: Redisperse any settled pigments 
by stirring with a paint paddle/mixer followed by thorough 
mixing to a uniform, homogeneous consistency. Catalyze 
paint component by adding SWC010 catalyst at a ratio of 
10 parts per volume paint and 1 part per volume catalyst, 
10:1 ratio per volume. Mix thoroughly to a uniform 
consistency. Avoid high speed agitation. 
Pot-life: 2-4 Hours (dependent on temperature 
and humidity). 
 
 
THINNING / REDUCTION: Not required. 
 
 
 
 
APPLICATION EQUIPMENT: Apply on cabinet doors and 
boxes by using Graco HVLP paired with # 3 needle, or a Fuji 
HVLP paired with a 1.3 needle or Graco GX19 with a 308 tip. 
 
APPLICATION GUIDELINES: Apply coating at a wet film 
thickness of 3-4mils (dry film 1.3-1.6mils). To obtain a 
uniform free from defect surface, fume on a complete tack 
coat followed by two wet-on-wet coats over the required 
area. Flooding one area should be avoided as too thick a 
coating will take longer to dry and create an uneven surface 
with visible defects. Coating should be applied in a well-
ventilated area at an adequate application temperature 
15°C – 30°C (60°F – 85°F) The paint has been formulated 
to provide minimal overspray. Acetone wiped surfaces 
should be painted within a 15-minute window. If 15 minutes 
have elapsed, re-wipe with acetone prior to painting. 
 
DRYING SCHEDULE:  
 
Air Dry@21°C-25°C (70°F – 77°F) and 50% relative humidity: 
 Surface dry: 20min, Dry to touch: 30min, Thorough Dry: 8hrs,  
Force Dry @50°C (120°F): Surface dry: 5min, Dry to touch: 
8min, Thorough Dry: 25min. Full properties obtained after a 7-
day cure period. 
 
CLEANUP: Thoroughly flush equipment and lines with warm 
water. 
 
PRECAUTIONS: Refer/Read Material Safety Data Sheet 
(MSDS), familiarize and observe all container warnings and 
labeling prior to use. Use in a well-ventilated area. Do not 
open containers until they are ready to use. Keep lid on 
container when not in use. Use in accordance with local 
regulations including environmental. Shelf Life 12 months 
maximum in original sealed unopened container. 
 
FOR INDUSTRIAL USE ONLY / PROTECT FROM FREEZE
